name: back
summary: Navigate back in browser history.

name: check
summary: Tick a checkbox or radio by @ref (idempotent — no-op if already checked).

name: click
summary: Click an element by its @ref from the last extract/snapshot.

args.name: button
args.description: Mouse button: left, right, or middle (default: left)

name: close
summary: Close the browser session and exit the agent loop.

name: dblclick
summary: Double-click an element by its @ref from the last extract/snapshot.

args.name: button
args.description: Mouse button: left, right, or middle (default: left)

name: dialog
summary: Set how JavaScript dialogs (alert/confirm/prompt) are auto-handled. Default accept.

name: done
summary: Signal that the goal is complete (AI surface only — no CDP side-effect).

args.name: answer
args.description: Final answer or short summary of the outcome

name: drag
summary: Drag an element from one @ref to another (full mouse drag-and-drop). MCP surface only.

name: emulate
summary: Emulate a device: viewport, DPR, mobile flag, touch, user-agent, color-scheme, safe-area insets. MCP surface only (the CLI has `ghostchrome emulate`).

args.name: device
args.description: Preset name, e.g. iphone-14-pro-max, pixel-7, ipad, desktop

args.name: mobile
args.description: Mobile viewport semantics (meta viewport, screen size)

args.name: user_agent
args.description: Override navigator.userAgent and the User-Agent header

args.name: reset
args.description: Drop every emulation override and restore the desktop viewport/UA

name: errors
summary: Return console and network errors observed on the current page.

name: eval
summary: Evaluate a JavaScript expression on the page and return the stringified result.

args.name: timeout_ms
args.description: Per-call deadline in ms (MCP surface only, default 8000)

name: extract
summary: Return a compact accessibility tree of the current page with @refs.

args.name: selector
args.description: Optional CSS selector to scope extraction

name: fill
summary: Fill multiple form fields in one call (JSONL convenience wrapper over type).

name: fill_form
summary: Fill multiple form fields in one call (MCP surface name for the JSONL 'fill' op).

args.name: fields
args.description: JSON object mapping @ref to text value

name: forward
summary: Navigate forward in browser history.

name: hover
summary: Hover over an element by @ref (reveals dropdowns, tooltips).

name: init
summary: Open the browser (no-op if already open). JSONL session lifecycle op.

name: navigate
summary: Load a URL in the current tab.

args.name: wait
args.description: load | stable | idle | none | domcontentloaded (default: load for JSONL/AI, domcontentloaded for MCP)

name: press
summary: Press a keyboard key; optionally focus an element by @ref first.

args.name: key
args.description: Key name, e.g. Enter, Escape, ArrowDown

name: reload
summary: Reload (refresh) the current page.

name: screenshot
summary: Capture the current viewport (or element) as a PNG/JPEG/WebP image.

args.name: quality
args.description: JPEG quality 1-100 (JSONL/AI); also used for WebP in MCP

args.name: format
args.description: webp | jpeg | png (MCP surface only, default: webp)

name: scroll_by
summary: Scroll the viewport vertically by dy pixels (positive = down).

name: scroll_to
summary: Scroll to an absolute Y position or to the bottom of the page.

args.name: bottom
args.description: If true, scroll to the page bottom

name: select
summary: Pick one or more options in a <select> element by @ref.

args.name: values
args.description: Option values to select (JSONL/AI: string array; MCP: 'value' string or JSON-array string)

name: snapshot
summary: All-in-one page report: navigate (optional) + errors + DOM extract. MCP surface only.

args.name: url
args.description: URL to navigate to before snapshotting (optional)

args.name: wait
args.description: Wait strategy: domcontentloaded | load | stable | idle | none

args.name: selector
args.description: Optional CSS selector to scope DOM extraction

name: swipe
summary: Swipe with a real single-finger touch gesture between two viewport coordinates. MCP surface only.

args.name: from_x
args.description: Start X in CSS pixels, relative to the viewport

args.name: from_y
args.description: Start Y in CSS pixels, relative to the viewport

name: tabs
summary: List, switch, close, or open browser tabs.

args.name: url
args.description: URL for action=new (blank tab when omitted)

name: type
summary: Type text into an input/textarea identified by @ref.

args.name: text
args.description: Text to type (field is cleared first)

args.name: submit
args.description: If true, press Enter after typing (submit the form)

name: uncheck
summary: Untick a checkbox by @ref (idempotent — no-op if already unchecked).

name: upload
summary: Upload file(s) to a file <input> element by @ref. MCP surface only.

args.name: paths
args.description: File path or JSON array of file paths

name: url
summary: Return the current page URL and title.

name: wait
summary: Wait for a selector/@ref, visible text, URL substring, load state, or a fixed delay.

args.name: ref
args.description: @ref from the last snapshot to wait for

args.name: text
args.description: Visible text substring to wait for

args.name: url
args.description: Wait until the current URL contains this substring

args.name: load
args.description: Page load state: load | domcontentloaded | idle | stable | none

args.name: state
args.description: Element state: attached | visible | hidden | enabled | stable (default: visible)

name: wait_for
summary: Wait for a @ref/selector/text/url/load condition. MCP surface only (JSONL uses 'wait').

args.name: ref
args.description: @ref from the last snapshot to wait for

args.name: text
args.description: Visible text substring to wait for

args.name: url
args.description: Wait until the current URL contains this substring

args.name: load
args.description: Page load state: load | domcontentloaded | idle | stable | none

args.name: state
args.description: Element state: attached | visible | hidden | enabled | stable (default: visible)

args.name: timeout_ms
args.description: Maximum wait time in ms (default 5000, max 30000)
